subject: Request: Phased billing + extended remit for Solstice Health
messages:
From: Emily Cole <emily.cole@solsticehealth.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Solstice Health Billing Ops <billing@solsticehealth.com>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Billing request for Q4 pilot — phased invoices + net-90

Markus,

Thanks again for the product walkthrough last week. We're excited to move the pilot forward for our Telehealth ops team, but I need to flag a billing constraint on our side. Our funding cadence is seasonal: the primary budget release happens in late Q4. Could Redwood accept a phased invoicing schedule for the pilot (split into three invoices tied to milestones) and Net-90 payment terms for each invoice?

Attached is our PO placeholder for signatures. If you need procurement language, our legal team prefers milestone-based invoices and a single POC for billing. Happy to jump on a quick call to sort details.

Best,
Emily Cole
Director of Procurement
Solstice Health

Attachments: Solstice_PO_2026Q3.pdf (PDF, 98KB)

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Billing request for Q4 pilot — phased invoices + net-90

Folks — forwarding Solstice's ask. High level: $120k pilot over 6 months, they want 3 invoices (milestone split) and Net-90 on each invoice. Procurement wants milestone language and a single billing contact.

Why I'm escalating: this is outside standard Net-30 terms and quarterly invoicing we typically accept only for enterprise with committed capacity. Solstice is strategic (clinical pilot) and high reference value; losing timing could push the pilot to a competitor.

Key questions for approval:
- Approve Net-90 on milestone invoices for the pilot?
- Any revenue recognition or credit concerns we should flag to finance?
- Do we require a refundable deposit or proof-of-funds to mitigate risk?

I've attached a suggested phased billing plan (draft). If we can get exec sign-off today or tomorrow we can turn around their PO.

Thanks,
Markus
VP, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: proposed_phased_billing_plan.xlsx (Excel, 12KB)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Fwd: Billing request for Q4 pilot — phased invoices + net-90

Markus — thanks for the context and the draft plan. Quick summary from legal/finance viewpoint after a fast sync with Treasury:

- Net-90 materially increases credit exposure for a $120k pilot; treasury prefers Net-30 but can accept Net-60 with compensating controls.
- We can make a one-off Net-90 approval if either: (a) Solstice provides a signed purchase order AND a refundable 20% deposit upon PO execution, or (b) Solstice executes our standard commercial paper (AP acknowledgement) and provides a credit reference (vendor score >= B+).
- For phased invoices: acceptable as milestone billing; finance needs clear acceptance criteria mapped to each milestone (dev sign-off, data ingest complete, ROI review session).
- Revenue recognition: we need milestone language to avoid recognizing revenue prior to acceptance.

Recommendation to deal desk / execs: Approve milestone invoicing + Net-60 by default. For Net-90, require the refundable 20% deposit or signed credit reference. If Sales wants Net-90 with no deposit, escalate to COO/CFO for one-time waiver.

I've drafted suggested approval language below for exec sign-off: 
"Approve phased milestone invoicing for Solstice Health pilot per attached plan. Grant conditional Net-90 payment terms contingent on receipt of a 20% refundable deposit or formal credit reference; otherwise Net-60 applies."

If you want, I can route a DocuSign amendment to the PO once we have their acceptance.

-Vanessa
Head of Customer Success Operations (Finance partner)
Redwood Inference
